rows.en: All right, you're on!
(Today I came to the pool with Miyuki again.)

Don't worry about it. Getting ready and all
must be a lot of work, huh.
The school pool's nothing to sneeze at, huh~
Yeah, I need to get my revenge for last time.
(Today I'm gonna study with Shirakawa!)
Sorry to keep you waiting, Shirakawa.
I just got here too.
So, shall we head to the library?
Hehe, you really were studying seriously.
I-I'm always serious.
Let's just say that's true, shall we?
That's a harsh way to put it...

Oh, I've got a little something to do
after this, so I'll head home first.
(Today I'm going to study with Miyuki.)
Sorry to keep you waiting, Miyuki~
Well then, let's head to the library!
I-I'm always serious.
Huh, that's kind of a harsh way to put it...
(Today I came to study with Shirakawa again!)
Did I keep you waiting, Shirakawa?
You're late. Keeping a girl waiting, really...

S-sorry... I forgot my pens and stuff...
Forgive me!!

Hehe, I'm just kidding!
Come on, let's go.
You worked hard again today.
rows.notes: x2, Miyuki; the player answers 'You think so?'

rows.en: Yes. You even ignored me when I called you.
rows.notes: x2, Miyuki (the player was too absorbed to hear).

rows.en: ...Seriously?

But I didn't want to disturb you,
so I just watched.

Your face when you're focused looked
pretty cool, you know.
rows.notes: x2, Miyuki, both genders (ririshii), so no gendered word.

rows.en: Ahaha... Thanks.
W-well then... See you...!
(Today I came to study with Miyuki again.)
Did I keep you waiting, Miyuki?

Geez... You're late.
Keeping me waiting like that...!
Huh... Seriously?

Yes. But I didn't want to disturb you,
so I just watched.
(Today I'm hanging out with Shirakawa!)

Just wandering around like this, with nowhere
in particular to go, is nice too.
Yeah, a day off like this isn't so bad.

Oh, a little knickknack shop!
Mind if we go take a look?

I'm sorry for dragging you
around everywhere.

Nah, I had fun too, so don't worry
about it at all.

Besides, I found out you're surprisingly
into cute stuff, Shirakawa.

N-never mind my tastes!
Geez, I'm not talking to you anymore!
rows.notes: x4, Miyuki, both genders and visits (mou, shirimasen, a playful sulk).

rows.en: (Today I came to hang out with Miyuki.)
Yeah, a day off like this isn't so bad.
I had fun too, so don't worry about it at all.

Besides, I found out you're surprisingly
into cute stuff, Miyuki!
(Today I came to hang out with Shirakawa again!)
Window shopping is nice too, isn't it?

Yeah, just wandering around without buying
anything is fun, huh.

Oh, I'd like to look at some clothes.
Mind if we go take a quick look?

I'm sorry again today for dragging
you around everywhere.
Besides, now I know your taste in clothes.
(Today I came to hang out with Miyuki again.)

Yeah, just wandering around without buying
anything is fun, right?

Nah, I had fun too, so don't worry
about it at all.
Besides, now I know your taste in clothes!

(Today I came to the artificial island
with Shirakawa!)
Nice weather again today, isn't it?

Yeah, if it rained after we came all the way
here, it'd be a total disaster.

Hehe, that's true...
Why don't we skip swimming today and take
a little walk instead?
That was fun, wasn't it?

Yeah, I thought the artificial island was just
beaches, but it's got other great views too, huh.

Yes, it was nice to make all sorts
of new discoveries.

Hey, Shirakawa.
Mind if I invite you out again?
Yes, I'll be waiting.

(Today I came to the artificial island
with Miyuki.)

Yeah, if it rained after we came all the way
here, it'd be a total disaster.

Yeah, I thought the artificial island was just
beaches, but it's got other great views too...

Hey, Miyuki.
Can I invite you out again?

(Today I came to the artificial island
with Shirakawa again!)
It's always clear skies here, isn't it?
Just like my heart.
Sigh... What are you even saying?
Let's walk a little, shall we?

I never thought there'd be such
a steep cliff over there.

That's true.
It seems dangerous if tourists wander in, though...

Well, I guess there's no point in us
worrying about it.
Guess we should head home soon.

uncertain: c11293 (x4, also c11344 in slice 155): mou, shirimasen rendered as a playful sulk 'Geez, I'm not talking to you anymore!'.
c11278: ririshii (shared by both genders) rendered 'pretty cool' to avoid a gendered word.
